Kev.text: Kev is the group's straight bettor: six of his eight settled bets are singles (4-2), and he is 5-3, up 1.10. Sulliver.text: Sulliver bets stars: Shai, Giannis, Wemby, Kyrie and Flagg props, all overs, mostly as singles, and it has gone 1-6 for minus 68.91.
